title: Automethylation of lysine methyltransferase SETDB1 on H3K9-like motifs regulates interactions with chromodomain proteins and controls its functions
authors: Cruz-Tapias P; Velasco G; Rapone R; Del Maestro L; Cochard V; Chevreux G; Joliot V; Boyarchuk E; Ait-Si-Ali S
one_liner_zh: 该文研究SETDB1自身甲基化调控其与染色质蛋白互作及H3K9me3建立，虽涉及蛋白-DNA相关染色质功能，但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作与组蛋白修饰，无TF-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract:
SUMMARY

Histone H3 lysine 9 trimethylation is essential for heterochromatin formation and maintenance, genome stability, and silencing of transposable elements (TEs) in embryonic stem cells (ESCs). The H3K9-specific lysine methyltransferase SETDB1 is crucial for mammalian development, as it controls ESC pluripotency and viability by regulating gene expression and TE silencing. Here, we demonstrate that SETDB1 undergoes automethylation on two lysine residues located within H3K9-like motifs in its catalytic domain. Notably, these automethylated lysines are necessary for the normal growth and viability of ESCs. While SETDB1 automethylation does not affect its catalytic activity, it is crucial for its interaction with chromodomain-containing partners, including SUV39H1, CDYL, and Heterochromatin Protein 1 gamma (HP1gamma). The integrity of the two automethylated lysines is required for SETDB1 localization to its target sites and for effective silencing of both coding genes and TEs. Expression of an automethylation-deficient SETDB1 fails to properly establish H3K9me3 and disrupts HP1gamma recruitment at target loci. Collectively, our findings uncover a previously unknown mechanism regulating SETDB1 function, essential for maintaining the fitness of mouse ESCs.

Highlights

– SETDB1 undergoes automethylation on two lysines within its catalytic domain – The automethylation-deficient form of SETDB1 is enzymatically active, yet it compromises mESCs fitness – SETDB1 automethylation-deficient mutant impairs chromatin association and pan-genomic H3K9me3 landscape – SETDB1 automethylation regulates its interactions with many chromodomain-containing partners
abstract_zh:
摘要

组蛋白H3赖氨酸9三甲基化对于异染色质的形成与维持、基因组稳定性以及胚胎干细胞（ESCs）中转座元件（TEs）的沉默至关重要。H3K9特异性赖氨酸甲基转移酶SETDB1通过调控基因表达和TE沉默来控制ESC多能性和生存能力，因此对哺乳动物发育至关重要。在此，我们证明SETDB1在其催化结构域内两个位于H3K9样基序中的赖氨酸残基上发生自身甲基化。值得注意的是，这些自身甲基化的赖氨酸对于ESCs的正常生长和生存能力是必需的。虽然SETDB1自身甲基化不影响其催化活性，但它对于与含染色质域（chromodomain）的伙伴（包括SUV39H1、CDYL和异染色质蛋白1γ（HP1gamma））的相互作用至关重要。两个自身甲基化赖氨酸的完整性是SETDB1定位到其靶位点以及有效沉默编码基因和TEs所必需的。表达自身甲基化缺陷型SETDB1无法正确建立H3K9me3，并破坏靶位点的HP1gamma招募。总体而言，我们的发现揭示了一种先前未知的调控SETDB1功能的机制，该机制对于维持小鼠ESCs的适应性至关重要。

亮点

– SETDB1在其催化结构域内的两个赖氨酸上发生自身甲基化 – 自身甲基化缺陷型SETDB1具有酶活性，但损害mESCs的适应性 – SETDB1自身甲基化缺陷突变体损害染色质关联和全基因组H3K9me3景观 – SETDB1自身甲基化调控其与许多含染色质域伙伴的相互作用
